body:
Marissa Cole: Go/no-go check for Guided Onboarding Checklist beta today. Release window is 3:30–5pm PT. Can folks drop status on last-minute blockers + what we’re comfortable shipping behind the flag?

Marissa Cole: Reminder: we said limited cohort for beta (new orgs + allowlist) and *not* default-on. Need signoff on: feature flag targeting, telemetry health, rollback plan, and Support enablement.

ReleaseBot: :information_source: Deploy train `console-web` cut at 15:00 PT. Next prod deploy slot: 16:00 PT. Please add any release-blocking issues in-thread.

Dylan Brooks: Console side is basically ready. Checklist shell + step state API + validators are in `main` behind `onboarding_checklist_beta`. Only thing I’m nervous about is the streaming validator edge case we fixed yesterday—needs a sanity pass in prod-like.

Chloe Martin: Backend state model is stable. We’re storing per-org/per-project checklist state server-side; client only sends “intent” events. API endpoints are behind auth + permission checks. No open Sev-1.

Leila Farouk: E2E suite is green on `staging` as of this morning, but we still have a flaky run ~1/20 on “streaming session completes” because the SSE mock can time out. Not blocking for beta, but I’d prefer we keep cohort small until we see real traffic.

Logan Wright: Telemetry pipeline: ingestion is healthy in staging + prod, but we had a short delay spike in `eu-west` earlier today (backlog cleared). If we scope beta to US regions first, we reduce risk. Dashboards are ready.

Nadia Rahman: +1 on scoping. Also reminder from privacy review: properties are allowlisted. No prompt/response bodies. We’re good there. We should confirm the Console is not accidentally sending raw URLs w/ query params for doc links (UTMs ok).

Kaitlyn Nguyen: API key flow: the “test vs prod” labeling is in and the checklist step reads from the same source. I verified 401 confusion case (wrong env key) is now much harder to hit. Only nit: copy in the modal says “production key” but docs say “prod key” — writers said they’ll unify next week.

Dev Patel: Support enablement: macros are drafted, but we’re not done training the whole team. For beta, fine if cohort is small + allowlist so we can handle escalations manually. Please make sure there’s a “Reset checklist state” path for us.

Dylan Brooks: Admin override to reset state is in (PR 48319). It’s gated to internal admins only. Support workflow is basically: ask for org slug + project id, then reset.

Marissa Cole: Can someone paste the current flag targeting config we intend to ship?

Ethan Park: Here’s what’s queued for prod:
```
flag: onboarding_checklist_beta
rules:
  - if org_created_at >= 2026-02-01 AND region == "us-east-1" then rollout: 0.05
  - if org_id in ALLOWLIST then rollout: 1.0
  - else rollout: 0.0
notes:
  - allowlist maintained in console-admin
  - kill switch: set rollout 0.0 on all rules
```
We can adjust % live without deploy.

Marissa Cole: Great. That matches the beta plan doc.

Leila Farouk: QA note: the “first successful request” validator has a ~1–3 min lag because it’s reading from gateway metrics, not direct request logs. So step might sit at “pending” briefly even after user runs quickstart. We should be okay as long as UI copy says “may take a minute to update”. Does it?

Dylan Brooks: Yep, we added microcopy: “We’ll auto-check this after your first API call (can take ~2 minutes).” :thumbsup:

Nadia Rahman: Telemetry: we should verify the dedupe keys are stable (so refreshes don’t spam). Last time we saw duplicates when the user toggled projects.

Chloe Martin: Dedupe is server-enforced for the state update endpoints (idempotency key on `org_id + project_id + step_id + day`). Event stream still might see duplicates, but dashboards use distinct step completion events.

Logan Wright: I’ll set a short-lived alert specifically for the beta: if `onboarding.step_completed` drops to 0 for >10m in `us-east-1`, page @eng-oncall. Also watching event lag >5m.

Dev Patel: Biggest support risk is 429 confusion. Can we confirm the checklist links to the rate limit/quota docs *and* the Console quota page? People get lost.

Marissa Cole: It links to both. Step CTA goes to Console Quotas, secondary link to docs (with UTMs).

Kaitlyn Nguyen: One more known issue: if a user creates a key, then deletes it immediately, the checklist can still show “API key created” as complete (because it’s “ever created”). That’s intended for beta; we can revisit.

Dylan Brooks: That’s in the PRD—“ever created” is fine. We don’t want folks to get stuck for deleting a test key.

Marissa Cole: Any release blockers? I’m hearing: (1) E2E streaming step flaky (not prod issue), (2) possible region lag for telemetry (mitigated by US-only), (3) validator lag copy is in.

Leila Farouk: No blockers from QA if we keep it 5% new orgs and allowlist for any existing customers we’re actively monitoring.

Logan Wright: Telemetry is a GO for US-only. If we expand regions later, I want 24h of clean health first.

Dev Patel: Support is a GO with the cohort constraint + internal reset tool. Please post the runbook link here so we can reference it.

Dylan Brooks: Runbook: `confluence/eng-platform/runbooks/console-checklist-feature-flag-rollout` (rollback section is solid). Also FYI: we can hard-disable the entire checklist route with the flag if something goes sideways.

Nadia Rahman: Privacy is a GO. Just please don’t change event properties today without looping me in—allowlist is strict.

Alex Martinez: From DevEx side: I’m comfortable proceeding with limited cohort. Success criterion for week 1 is “no major regressions + we can measure drop-off.” Let’s not chase perfect.

Marissa Cole: OK decision: GO for beta today with limited cohort:
- `us-east-1` only
- 5% new orgs created after 2026-02-01
- allowlist for 10–15 known friendly accounts
- Support on standby + reset tool available
- telemetry health alerts enabled

Marissa Cole: Dylan/Chloe please confirm the deploy is still on track for 16:00 PT and that the flag is default-off.

Dylan Brooks: Confirmed. Flag default-off. We’ll deploy at 16:00 PT, then flip allowlist first, then 5% after we validate events.

Chloe Martin: +1. I’ll be around for the first hour post-flip to watch API error rates on checklist endpoints.

ReleaseBot: :white_check_mark: Release note drafted for beta (internal only). Next reminder at 15:50 PT for pre-deploy checklist.

Marissa Cole: Cool. Dropping pre-deploy checklist here for completeness:
- [ ] Confirm prod flag default = 0%
- [ ] Confirm allowlist populated
- [ ] Confirm dashboards loading (funnel + telemetry health)
- [ ] Confirm rollback path (set rollout 0.0 + verify UI hides)
- [ ] Confirm Support macro links + reset instructions

Marissa Cole: See you all at 15:50 PT for the quick check-in.
